description: Additional field-rule cases. Same shape as field-rules-vectors but expected values are exact strings: masked_body, masked_query and masked_resp_body are the literal output of apply_field_rules / apply_resp_field_rules (Python json.dumps text with default separators and ensure_ascii; urlencode(doseq=True) text). input.salt is STUBSMITH_MASK_SALT (null means unset). input.project_defaults mirrors the sync project_defaults object (null means none synced; a defaults object that compiles to no rules is the same as none). email_domain null means the module default.
